question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.**

They took a while to **__establish the threat__**.
solution:
The correct answer is **"recognise the threat."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"establish"** means to set up or found something. (संस्‍था, व्‍यवस्‍था आदि स्‍थापित करना, निर्धारित करना)

 
 
• **Example**: *The school was **established**__ in 1875.*
 
 
 
• **"Recognise" **means to identify or acknowledge something. (किसी को पहचानना (पहले देखे या सुने को दुबारा जानना))
 __
 
• **Example**: *I **recognized**__ him but I couldn’t remember his name.*
 
 
 
• In the given sentence, the context suggests that the subject is trying to identify a potential threat.
 
• Therefore, **"recognise the threat" **is the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment.
 
• The correct answer is option 1.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2, "manifest,"** means to make the threat visible or apparent. (किसी वस्‍तु को स्‍पष्‍टतया प्रकट करना या प्रकट होना)
 
• **Option 3, "negotiate,"** means to try to reach a compromise or agreement with the threat. (किसी मुद्दे पर निर्णय या समझौते के लिए किसी से बातचीत करना; परक्रामण करना)
 
• **Option 4, "move," **means to physically relocate the threat. (स्‍थान बदलना या किसी वस्‍तु को अन्‍य स्‍थान पर ले जाना, हिलना या हिलाना; खिसकना या खिसकाना)

35:Te4c,
The correct answer is **"Integrate."**
